justifications.type_expressiveness: Newtype JobId, public JobState enum, and an internal JobStatus that carries retry_at as data show solid domain modeling, though duplicating public/internal state enums is a minor missed simplification.
justifications.error_handling: Typed QueueError enum with distinguishing variants and Display impl; uses an assert! in new and an expect in checkout without documented reasoning, falling short of a clean 3.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Public surface is reasonable with appropriate derives on JobId/JobState, but there are no doc comments on any public items and QueueError doesn't implement std::error::Error.
justifications.idiomaticity: Uses ?, derives, and pattern matching reasonably well, but the checkout loop is manual rather than iterator-based, clones the payload unnecessarily, and uses an awkward two-pass borrow pattern instead of more idiomatic approaches.
